description: One of your competitor UGC scans (from ugc_scan): its status and progress while the worker runs (queued → finding competitors → fetching ads → measuring → writing → summary → done), then the board: each competitor's winning UGC ads ranked by signal (days running, variants, reach, CTR percentile, views) with the one-line reason each won, and "what wins in your category" (top hooks, formats, lengths and offers) as markdown and structured fields. Ads already in the Refs library carry REF ids for get_blueprint, get_frames and plan_video; the scan's own ads carry ugc:<scan>:<film> refs, and get_ugc_scan(id, film) returns one's blueprint. plan.prompt is a ready brief for planning the user's own UGC ad. Private to you; Pro, free in credits.

film.description: A film from the board (its film id or ugc:… ref): returns its blueprint

id.description: A scan id from ugc_scan, a refs.video/ugc/… link, a ugc:<scan>:<film> ref, or the product link you scanned

name: get_ugc_scan
title: Get a competitor UGC scan and its board
